name: security-audit
author: Marchand
description: Hunt for common vulnerabilities and unsafe patterns.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Security audit of the project or a path
commands.prompt: Audit {args} for security problems: injection (SQL/shell/HTML), path traversal, hard-coded secrets, unsafe deserialization, weak crypto, missing auth checks, unsafe file/network handling, vulnerable dependency usage. Search the code with the search tool, read the suspicious spots, and report findings ranked by severity with file:line and a fix. Do not edit unless I ask.
